Surat-Bilimora Bullet Train Section to be Electrified

The 50-kilometer Surat-Bilimora section of the bullet train project in Gujarat is scheduled to be electrified on November 20. The National High-Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL) will energize this section with 25,000 volts.
